description: Linux x86_64 GTK4/libadwaita Hammer editor (hammer_gtk) with its viewports on the RFC 0016 render core (Vulkan), on X11 and Wayland displays (RFC 0002 R17).

intent.frame_transport: dmabuf (render.device clause D18) with a read-back fallback
intent.support_scope: The editor's viewports: textured Source materials, captures, asset reload, resize, sharing one device between documents, and teardown. Not the full R25 editor workflow.
intent.packaging: hammer/gtk/build.sh: the Waf tools product with --render-core-vulkan=on in its own tree (build-hammer-gtk), copied to the path given; KTX2 previews with KTX_SOURCE_ROOT/KTX_BUILD_ROOT (build-hammer-gtk-ktx)

compositor.note: The isolated test compositor (headless, a virtual monitor, Xwayland for the X11 profile); never the user's session.

required_checks: Source architecture and changed-region style checks

evidence.note: Local runs in the isolated compositor; see RFC/0002-progress.md, R17 closure. No hosted CI lane and no run on a physical desktop session.
